answer.value: Commercial and research use in multiple languages. quotes: Intended Use Cases: Llama 4 is intended for commercial and research use in multiple languages.
Instruction tuned models are intended for assistant-like chat and visual reasoning tasks, whereas pretrained models can be adapted for natural language generation.
For vision, Llama 4 models are also optimized for visual recognition, image reasoning, captioning, and answering general questions about an image.
The Llama 4 model collection also supports the ability to leverage the outputs of its models to improve other models including synthetic data generation and distillation.
